svg.title: Corner bracket
svg.desc:
One corner bracket from Cru's corners.svg, isolated as a seamless tile. The source is a 1920x1080 composition: a #FFD000 field with 14 by 8 of these marks on a regular 132.55px grid. Using that file directly would either stretch the marks or repeat its uneven margins, so one mark is lifted out and centred in a single cell instead. Geometry is the source's, translated to the origin. Painted opaque white because this is used as a mask image: the shape is the mask and the colour comes from a theme token at the use site, so the pattern follows the theme rather than pinning the source's two hex values.
Kept in a desc element rather than an XML comment on purpose. A comment cannot contain a double hyphen, so naming a CSS custom property in one makes the file unparseable as an image while fetch still returns 200 and the right MIME type.
